# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

Degusta serves a restaurant digital menu as a vertical, Reels-style video feed (one dish per screen, autoplay, muted, loop) reached by scanning a table QR code, and takes the order from it: cart, delivery or pickup, sent to the store's WhatsApp, then managed in the panel (orders, caixa, fiado, counter sales).

### Business problem

- Static menus do not show dishes; owner turns 1 photo into a short AI video (or uploads own video) per dish.
- Customers can order from the menu (cart → checkout → WhatsApp message); there is no online payment, Pix goes straight to the store's key and the owner confirms it.
- Owner monetizes via plans + add-on generation packs (Stripe/Cashier, BRL).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| Restaurant customer (browser) | Reads public feed `/r/{slug}`; reports watch time |
| Restaurant owner | Manages menu in Livewire panel `/painel` |
| Super admin | Operates platform in Filament 5 `/admin` |
| Mux | Video asset hosting/playback; webhook `POST /webhooks/mux` |
| Stripe (Laravel Cashier) | Subscriptions, invoices; `StripeWebhookListener` |
| Gemini Veo | Photo-to-video AI provider (`config/ai.php`, default `null` provider) |
| S3 | File storage (`config/filesystems.php`) |
| Brevo/Mailpit | Mail (Mailpit in Sail) |

### Macro flow

1. Owner registers (`/cadastro`), verifies e-mail, creates categories and dishes in `/painel`.
2. Owner picks 1 photo + AI style preset → `RequestVideoGeneration` checks balance, creates `VideoGeneration`, queues `GenerateDishVideo`.
3. Provider generates clip; `PollDishVideoGeneration` polls async providers; asset goes to Mux.
4. Mux webhook `video.asset.ready` → video status `aguardando_aprovacao`; owner is notified (`VideoReadyForReview`).
5. Owner approves (`ApproveVideo`) → video becomes dish `active_video`; `DebitGenerationBalance` writes `uso` ledger entries.
6. `FeedBuilder` lists dishes with approved active video; customer scans QR, scrolls feed.
7. Feed POSTs batched watch time to `/r/{slug}/visualizacoes` → `dish_views`; owner reads metrics in `/painel/visualizacoes`.
8. `videos:prune` (daily 04:00) deletes unchosen/replaced/unreviewed videos.

### Ordering and cash (Phases 1–8 of `pedidos-caixa-degusta`)

- Public: cart/checkout in JS (`resources/js/cart.js`, `checkout.js`), `POST /r/{slug}/pedidos` (`PlaceOrder`, prices recomputed on the server by `OrderPricer`), coupon check, funnel events, tracking page `/p/{token}`, courier link `/entregador/{token}`.
- Panel: orders manager, PDV, caixa, fiado, report, products (pizza/kg/promo), complements, coupons, loyalty, customers, couriers, settings (hours, delivery by neighborhood or distance, Pix), help center, 9-step setup guide, menu styles (vidro/claro/rústico).
- Personal data: address and notes cleared 30 days after an order ends; customers erased on request or after 2 years without orders.

### Out of scope

- Online payment (card/Pix gateway): the owner confirms Pix and card on delivery manually.
